test_title: PYST 70: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 29 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Balram starts from Point A and drives 15 km towards south. He then takes a left turn, drives 12 km, turns left and drives 16 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 13 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 1 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again?

(All turns are 90 degree turns only unless specified)7010
solution:
**Given:**

Balram starts from Point A.

→ Drives 15 km towards south

→ Takes a left turn and drives 12 km

→ Takes a left turn and drives 16 km

→ Takes a left turn and drives 13 km

→ Takes a final left turn and drives 1 km to reach Point P

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b01985fcb2d3cf84773d6d56ab795ca71385220f586695c268909b905316b39.png] 

Point P is 1 km west of Point A.

So, to reach Point A again, Balram must move:

→ 1 km towards east

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
